content.text:
I've submitted index 24 (Bi 0.29 / Fe 0.18 / V 0.53) as the best composition, and the episode is closed. The library has 201 compositions and there were only 3 photocurrent measurements, so this is the best of three. It is probably not the best in the library.

| Index | Bi / Fe / V | Photocurrent |
|---|---|---|
| 35 | 0.43 / 0.16 / 0.41 | 7.1 µA |
| **24** | 0.29 / 0.18 / 0.53 | **26.7 µA** |
| 47 | 0.24 / 0.15 / 0.61 | 18.3 µA |

- **Starting point:** I began at index 35, the candidate closest to BiVO₄ (equal Bi and V, little Fe). BiVO₄ is the well-known photoanode in this system, and I chose that start from prior knowledge, not from any data here.
- **Adding vanadium:** Moving to a V-rich composition (index 24) gave about 3.8 times the photocurrent.
- **Going further:** Adding more V and less Bi (index 47) made it worse, so the peak is probably near index 24.

All three points have similar, low Fe (0.15–0.18), so I never tested the effect of iron. The Fe-rich part of the library is completely unexplored. I also didn't use any of the 5 XRD measurements. They wouldn't have added to the score, which only counts compositions with a measured photocurrent.
